animationRetarget.method: Measured anatomical limb axes, target-local grip frames, canonical LOD0 pose shared across every LOD; no heading offsets or wrist patches
animationRetarget.rootMotion: No source planar translation or scale; target anatomical limb lengths retained; vertical pelvis/contact measured on LOD0 skin, including actual idle-leg composition for bow; bounded cloth-helper offsets audited separately

projectDeath.method: Existing additive motion resolved on fitted rest; full dead-cloth follow, bounded late ankle relaxation, and whole-skin ground contact baked once into a normal target clip

ankleSettle.interpolation: smoothstep; original early joint motion retained

construction.method: Periodic Gaussian smoothing, sigma=1 sample, then uniform majorant offset; C2 periodic cubic spline; positive periodic Gaussian bumps at measured between-frame failures

validation.temporalLimitation: Finite sampling, not continuous collision detection; final exported GLB interpolation must be rechecked
validation.selectedGeometry: 2180 cape triangles with all vertex cape weight > .8 and 1004 lower-leg/foot/toe triangles with all vertex limb weight > .5 and cape weight < .01

visualAcceptance: Focused offline production-runtime poses were visually reviewed for source appearance, locomotion, weapon grips, mounted composition and death. This is not browser/GPU/manual play acceptance or a claim of continuous collision-free cloth; final real-LOD matrix evidence is recorded separately.
knownLimitations: Cloth uses fitted helper bones and baked poses; no dynamic cloth collision.
Anatomical scalp is concealed by the Shadow Warden hood; measured height is the source envelope.
The target-only grounded death retains a slightly propped prone shape from the authored motion; contacting extremities do not imply a fully flat torso.
Raw source-mode bow poses may hover: gameplay retains the bow pelvis while replacing leg tracks with locomotion legs, and the fitted contact bake preserves that composed stance.
The inherited short early two-handed-axe runtime transition can briefly dip feet about 2–4 cm; the shared blend and body/root behavior are unchanged.
Hard angular inner-sleeve folds remain visible in some raised-arm poses; localized lining closes the reviewed openings without claiming smooth cloth simulation.
The existing two-handed axe support hand retains its partly open/sliding source pose, emphasized by the low-poly fingers.

Per-frame locomotion planting removes authored airborne run clearance. Actual idle/run fades on the reviewed fitted targets can briefly dip soles about 2.5–4.7 cm; source-clearance-preserving locomotion remains unfinished.
Coarse LOD2 final death contact can retain about 3.7–7.5 mm of surface-floor penetration under the shared identical animation.

rangedGripCalibration.method: Opposite anatomical shaft polarity from sword; unchanged measured palm center and normal.
rangedGripCalibration.review: Actual production held pilum phase .28, front/side/rear; fingers wrap shaft on all three models; release event unchanged.
